description: This Java class defines a UI widget for controlling a boolean configuration flag in the rusefi project. It provides a panel with a checkbox that can send commands to toggle a setting and update its state based on sensor data.

classes.name: BooleanFlagControlPanel
classes.description: A panel component with a checkbox to control a boolean configuration flag, capable of sending commands and updating its state based on sensor data.

methods.name: BooleanFlagControlPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the panel with label and checkbox captions.

methods.name: getControl
methods.description: Returns the main content JPanel containing the checkbox and label.

methods.name: installCommand
methods.description: Adds an action listener to the checkbox to send a command when toggled.

methods.name: installStatusReader
methods.description: Sets up a sensor listener to update checkbox state based on sensor data.
